items.title: Landlords flex rental power as data center viability becomes ‘everybody’s problem’
items.summary: Data center supply is being snapped up as quickly as it hits the market, and landlords are taking a more cautious approach to how they structure leases, a partner at Vinson & Elkins said.

items.title: Why Is CBRE (CBRE) Down 1.5% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: CBRE (CBRE) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Question
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: 3 Profitable Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: While profitability is essential, it doesn’t guarantee long-term success. Some companies that rest on their margins will lose ground as competition intensifies — as Jeff Bezos said, “Your margin is my opportunity”.

items.title: New York beats out San Francisco for top tech talent hub: Trial Balance
items.summary: AI hiring and a growing appetite for tech talent among financial services firms are helping shift the center of the tech workforce to the East Coast.

items.title: New York surpasses San Francisco as top U.S. tech talent market
items.summary: New York City's 394,300 tech talent jobs edged out the San Francisco Bay Area's 375,730, the first time NY has led in 13 years of CBRE analysis

items.title: San Francisco Bay Area dethroned as largest tech talent market
items.summary: The size of New York's tech talent workforce surpassed the San Francisco Bay Area for the first time as tech companies lay off workers, a new report from CBRE shows.

items.title: Big-Box Leasing Propels Chicago Industrial Market to Top 3
items.summary: Chicago industrial leasing hit 6.1M SF in Q2, ranking third nationally as big-box deals and data center demand drove absorption.
